messages:
jon-support: FYI customer acme-prod reported p99 jump from ~300ms -> ~2.5s starting 03:10 UTC. No 5xxs, all 200s. They called out very short prompts ("hi") and bursts. Ticket #7890 opened.

maria-eng-sre: thanks. what changed in last deploy? any batcher config rollouts? please paste the live config + commit id.

elaine-eng-platform: rolling diff from last deploy: ```
batcher: 
  continuous: true
  max_batch_size: 64
  batch_timeout_ms: 50
  grace_window_ms: 15
  greedy_small_prompts: false
```
commit: f3a7c9b (platform/batcher: increase timeout for throughput)

sam-eng-runtime: seeing matching telemetry — p95 ~350ms, p99 ~2.4s. heatmap shows a fat tail when tiny-prompts spike (10-100 reqs/s bursts). queue_length occasionally spikes to 60 which then drains in one big batch -> tail.

maria-eng-sre: ok likely cause: increasing batch_timeout_ms caused tiny requests to wait longer creating buildup during microbursts -> one-shot big batches that inflate p99. quick mitigation options:
- roll batch_timeout_ms back to 10ms
- enable greedy_small_prompts=true so tiny prompts flush sooner
- enable single-shot fallback when queue_depth>threshold (500ms SLA path)

elaine-eng-platform: quick patch prepared. curl to canary the config in prod region eu-west-1: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/configs/canary \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"batcher":{"batch_timeout_ms":10,"greedy_small_prompts":true}}'
```
apply will affect 10% of hosts.

jon-support: customer wants repro steps so they can validate on their side. can we give a short script to reproduce?

sam-eng-runtime: reproduce with a tiny-prompt microburst:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 250); do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"input":"hi"}' &
  sleep 0.003
done
wait
```
that creates queueing and shows p99 tail locally.

maria-eng-sre: rolling the canary now (eu-west-1, 10% hosts). monitoring: p99_latency, batcher_queue_length, avg_batch_size, and per-host cpu. target: p99 drop back <700ms and queue_length <20. will escalate to 50% if good in 10m. notify #incidents if any alert.

sre-bot: alert: batcher_queue_length > 50 in eu-west-1 for 3m (hosts affected: 7).

maria-eng-sre: saw bot alert, rollback canary to 0% and applying immediate fallback config (single_shot_threshold_ms:500). documenting follow-up: create postmortem if customer still sees p99 >1s after config revert; add e2e test for tiny-prompt microbursts in CI. jon-support please update ticket with mitigation steps and ETA (~15m) and ask customer to validate after we push. :white_check_mark:
